notes.item1: Elemento nativo — usa <textarea> HTML5 sem lib upstream. Estilizado via classes .nds-*.

notes.item4: Contador acessível — sempre aria-live="polite" + aria-label com "X de Y caracteres usados" para leitores de tela.

notes.title: Implementation Notes
notes.item1: Native element — uses HTML5 <textarea> with no upstream lib. Styled via .nds-* classes.
notes.item2: Height — does not follow the content. field-sizing: content is not applied: browser support is uneven and the same field would be a different height in each one. Height comes from rows or from the .nds-min-h-* utilities; past that, the content scrolls.
notes.item3: Resize — controlled via .nds-* class (.nds-resize-y, .nds-resize-none, .nds-resize), not direct CSS prop.
notes.item4: Accessible counter — always aria-live="polite" + aria-label with "X of Y characters used" for screen readers.

item3.result: Blocks new characters; counter stays at maximum
